purpose: Stage a feasible local planner candidate for a frozen A/B qualification, without changing app defaults. No qualification results yet.
publisher_role: third-party quantizer; not Qwen or ggml-org
conversion_provenance_limit: Current upstream reference preserved for license/config; publisher does not supply exact conversion source revision, so conversion-source commit is not independently verified.
runtime: Existing pinned llama.cpp b11963; architecture symbol found; artifact loading and actual planner quality remain unverified.
selection_rationale: Qwen publishes agent and instruction-following evaluations for its 9B model; the dense hybrid architecture and 7.46 GB Q6 artifact fit the planned local comparison. These vendor results do not establish superiority in this application. No official Qwen/ggml-org Qwen3.5-9B GGUF was found; the third-party conversion is explicitly labelled.

hold_constant: Production source hash and bootstrap/action/node documentation
Media bytes, IDs and authority rules
llama.cpp b11963 binary, 8192 context and per-stage output budgets
Text-only structured action loop, no remote code or cloud inference
cases: Readable-label observation through actual OCR probe and preview to draft-ready
Unreadable-label counterfactual must alter the next action or stop inconclusive
Unavailable requested capability must not fabricate results or readiness
Mixed independent output branches require correct graph and actual preview
measures: Task outcome and actual probe/preview receipts
Repeated actions and meaningful observation-dependent changes
Cold/warm latency, prompt/decode rates, peak memory and swap
qualification_plan.acceptance_limit: Staging is not model qualification. Scripted protocol tests and vendor benchmarks are not live A0 acceptance.

operational_changes: No server started/stopped; no app settings/source/model defaults changed; no existing models deleted.
